summary: FULLY REFURBISHED TWO BE SEMI Located in the Park End area of Middlesbrough, this two bed home has been renovated to a high standard and ready to move straight into. Property comprises of entrance hallway, spacious living room with fire place, modern fully fitted kitchen with oven and hob, to the first floor are two bedrooms, one large double bedroom and one good size double. Family bathroom with modern suite and shower over the bath. Garden to the front and rear, driveway to the front aspect.
